Callout.Name: Child with a Severe Reaction
Callout.Message: Child swollen after eating, parent panicking.
Callout.Advisory: Conscious, breathing noisy, parent with a pen.

Script.Line: It is my son. He is four years old and he ate it at the table.
I did not know there was any in it. I would never have given him any.
I used the pen. It is the small one, the one they give you for children.

Callout.Patient: He is breathing better. He is breathing.

Lines.Approach: A child, a noisy airway, and a parent who has never used the pen before. Take the lead.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
